paragraphs: He speaks in the name of Rav Huna: [Arakhin 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Arakhin.13b.4).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli first attributes the ruling directly to Rav Huna, then gives the version in which Rav Zavdi speaks in his name. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1067&lang=en) cites this second form.
